land_description: Buy Telegram Stars and Premium with a single request. No KYC, no seed phrases, fully open source.
land_features_subtitle: One API for purchases, deposits and analytics — no manual work in the Fragment interface.
land_feature_stars_text: Buy stars for any user by username — one at a time or for a whole list of recipients at once.
land_feature_premium_text: Gift Premium by username, with the recipient checked before the purchase.
land_feature_gifts_text: Gift models: lists by collection and data for a specific model.
land_feature_deposit_text: Top up your balance straight from your wallet or with a regular transfer with a memo.
land_feature_logs_text: A notification for every transaction arrives in the Telegram chat you choose.
land_feature_stats_text: Balance, spending on Stars and Premium, and transaction history — in the dashboard and via the API.
land_how_title: Your first request in three steps
land_how_step_1_text: One-click sign-in through Telegram — no passwords, KYC or seed phrases.
land_how_step_2_text: Send TON from your wallet — the funds are credited automatically.
land_how_step_3_title: Create a token and send a request
land_how_step_3_text: The token is issued in the dashboard. After that it is a regular HTTP request with an Authorization header.
land_pricing_subtitle: No subscriptions or hidden charges. Or host the service yourself — for free.
land_plan_cloud_text: A ready-made service at fragapi.com. We look after the infrastructure — you send requests.
land_plan_cloud_item_1: Up and running in a couple of minutes
land_plan_cloud_item_2: Dashboard with statistics and API tokens
land_plan_self_text: Deploy FragAPI on your own server. All the code is open under the MIT license.
land_plan_self_item_2: The same API and the same dashboard
land_cta_subtitle: Log in via the Telegram bot, top up your balance and send your first request in a couple of minutes.
faq_a1: Full Fragment automation through an API: no KYC, a low 1.8% fee, open source code, statistics, notifications and more.
faq_q2: Does the service charge a fee?
faq_a2: Yes, 1.8% of every transaction: on 1000 USD of purchases we take 18 USD. Self-hosted has no service fee. The network fee of ≈ $0.001 per transaction applies either way.
faq_q3: How do I top up my balance?
faq_a3: Send TON straight from the wallet connected in the dashboard, or with a regular transfer with a memo. The funds are credited automatically.
faq_q4: Do I need to pass KYC or enter a seed phrase?
faq_a4: No. You log in via the Telegram bot and top up with a TON transfer — no documents and no seed phrase.
faq_a5: Yes. All the code is open under the MIT license: deploy FragAPI on your own server and use the same API and dashboard with no service fee.
